scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:clients && bun run test:pack
scripts.fix: bun run fmt && bun -F asphodelos lint --fix && markdownlint-cli2 --fix && textlint --fix --ignore-path .gitignore '**/*.md'
scripts.lint: bun -F asphodelos lint && markdownlint-cli2 && textlint --ignore-path .gitignore '**/*.md' && cspell --no-progress --dot '**' && secretlint '**/*' && bun scripts/typespec.ts && bun scripts/actionlint.ts -color && bun scripts/zizmor.ts .github/workflows
scripts.test:clients: bun run build && bun -F @asphodelos/test typecheck && bun -F @asphodelos/test lint && bun -F @asphodelos/test test
